verdict.rationale: Reflect documents official Chrome and Safari extensions that bookmark websites and capture snippets from across the web, with the link and highlights automatically added to the daily note. That covers the core of an official browser clipper for highlights. Missing for 10: evidence of full-page or article-content clipping (beyond the link and selected snippets), the ability to choose a target note other than the daily note, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extensions.
